integrity: The claim is analytically proved using Parseval, exact rational expansion and exponential tilting; finite checks are supplementary only.
scientific_limitations: Quantified correction only for a single real-parameter Blaschke automorphism with fixed 2/3 < theta < 1.
Claim concerns normalized monomial images, not the norm of a bounded composition operator.
Earlier pointwise coefficient asymptotics may yield this weighted result after further summation; independent priority review remains needed.
title: Cubic stretched-exponential norm correction for Blaschke composition on weighted Hardy spaces
